question.:question/problem:
Consider the matrix $B,$ given by

$$
B=\begin{bmatrix}4 & -8 & 8 \\ 8 & -2 & 8 \\ 4 & -8 & 9\end{bmatrix}.
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $B?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+4{R}_{1} \\ {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+5{R}_{1}\end{aligned}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation ${R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+4{R}_{1}$ means that we need to add $4$ times the first row to the third row.

- The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+5{R}_{1}$ means that we need to add $5$ times the first row to the second row.

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =\begin{bmatrix}4 & -8 & 8 \\ 8 & -2 & 8 \\ 4 & -8 & 9\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+4{R}_{1} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}4 & -8 & 8 \\ 8 & -2 & 8 \\ 4+(4)(4) & -8+(4)(-8) & 9+(4)(8)\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}4 & -8 & 8 \\ 8 & -2 & 8 \\ 20 & -40 & 41\end{bmatrix}\quad {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+5{R}_{1} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}4 & -8 & 8 \\ 8+(5)(4) & -2+(5)(-8) & 8+(5)(8) \\ 20 & -40 & 41\end{bmatrix} \\  & \sim \begin{bmatrix}4 & -8 & 8 \\ 28 & -42 & 48 \\ 20 & -40 & 41\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
